ui.m9624b05272: What’s the difference between NFC and QR?
ui.m3499027c4d: NFC opens the item link with a tap on a compatible phone. QR is scanned with a phone camera. Both open the same fixed CliQo link.
ui.mfde11a3ac0: NFC reading depends on the phone and its settings. Visitors can use the QR camera option if NFC is unavailable. Writing NFC for a ready template requires a compatible phone and app.
ui.mcf6b9962e3: How do I activate my item?
ui.m52fc68f850: Sign in, scan the QR to identify your item, then enter the 6-digit activation code on the card inside the package to claim it. Scanning the QR alone does not claim ownership.
ui.m82cc191244: Do I need a new QR when I change the link?
